data.gender_notes: Nadeemah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nadeemah is an Arabic name that means 'friend' or 'companion'. It symbolizes the bond between individuals and the importance of relationships. The name Nadeemah carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadeemah usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Nadeemah is associated with the concept of companionship and friendship, emphasizing the value of strong social bonds.
data.etymology: Nadeemah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nadeemah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
